Deduce the description of the sections of the exact-support sheaf (proof lines 2293 and 2306-2308).
proof_roadmap: The local description of the sections (proof lines 2306-2308).
difficulty_reason: With the notation of a closed immersion i : Z -> X defined by an ideal I, the lemma asserts that the sheaf functor SheafHom(O_Z, -) is a right adjoint to i_* : Mod(O_Z) -> Mod(O_X), and that for an open V in Z the sections of SheafHom(O_Z, F) over V are the sections s of F over an open U of X with U cap Z = V that are annihilated by I (statement lines 2282-2293). The proof computes Hom_{O_X}(i_*G, F) = Hom_{i_*O_Z}(i_*G, SheafHom_{O_X}(i_*O_Z, F)) = Hom_{O_Z}(G, SheafHom(O_Z, F)), the first equality by Modules, Lemma labelled modules-lemma-adjoint-tensor-restrict and the second by the full faithfulness of i_* from Modules, Lemma labelled modules-lemma-i-star-equivalence, and leaves the description of sections to the reader (proof lines 2295-2308). Setting up the adjunction through the tensor-hom adjunction and the full faithfulness of pushforward is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
